title: Chapter 13 Revision: Future Tense
description: Mixed questions covering imperfective future (będę + inf), perfective future, future time expressions, and planning vocabulary.

questions.prompt: Jutro ___ w domu i uczyć się. (Tomorrow I will stay at home and study — ongoing.) [być, ja — imperfective future]
questions.explanation: Future auxiliary 'być', ja: będę. 'Jutro będę w domu i uczyć się.' Imperfective ongoing future.

questions.prompt: W końcu ___ ten projekt jutro! (I'll finally finish this project tomorrow!) [skończyć, ja — perfective future]
questions.explanation: Single completed future event, result = perfective: skończę. 'Będę kończyć' = imperfective (ongoing process without completion emphasis).

questions.prompt: 'Za tydzień wyjeżdżam.' What does 'za tydzień' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Za + accusative' = in X time from now. 'Za tydzień' = in a week. 'Wyjeżdżam' is present used for near future (planned departure).

questions.prompt: Mam nadzieję, że ___ egzamin. (I hope you'll pass the exam.) [zdać, ty — perfective future]
questions.explanation: 'Mam nadzieję, że' + future clause: 'zdasz' = perfective future of 'zdać' (ty). One completed result.

questions.prompt: Co ___ robić w weekend? (What will you (pl, mixed) be doing at the weekend?) [imperfective future, wy]
questions.explanation: 'Wy' (you plural) imperfective future: będziecie. 'Co będziecie robić?' = What will you all be doing?

options: to intend to / to plan to
questions.explanation: 'Zamierzam + infinitive' = I intend to / I'm planning to. 'Zamierzam wyjechać' = I intend to leave.

questions.prompt: 'Napiszę do ciebie e-mail.' What type of future is 'napiszę'?
questions.explanation: 'Napiszę' = perfective future. Conjugating 'napisać' (perfective) in 'present' = future tense. No auxiliary 'będę' needed.

questions.prompt: How do you say 'next week' in Polish?
questions.explanation: 'W przyszłym tygodniu' = next week (przyszły = next/future, tygodniu = locative of tydzień). 'Za tydzień' = in a week (different: from now).
'Marzyć o + locative' = to dream of/about. 'Marzę o podróży' = I dream of travelling.

questions.prompt: Planuję ___ do Krakowa w weekend. (I'm planning to go to Kraków this weekend.) [jechać — infinitive after planuję]
questions.explanation: 'Planuję' + infinitive: pojechać. Do NOT use conjugated future after planuję. 'Pojechać' = perfective infinitive of jechać.

questions.prompt: Identify the imperfective future: 'She will be reading all evening.'
questions.explanation: 'Będzie czytać' = imperfective future (będzie + infinitive). Duration 'cały wieczór' confirms ongoing. 'Przeczyta' = perfective (will finish reading).
'Pojutrze' = the day after tomorrow. 'Jutro' = tomorrow. 'Pojutrze wracam' = I'm coming back the day after tomorrow.
